test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements regarding GDP is correct?

I. GDP is used to measure human development.

II. Externalities are not taken into account while estimating GDP.

III. Services provided by housewives are included while estimating GDP.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• GDP is used to measure human development.
 
 
• This statement is incorrect.
 
• GDP measures the economic output of a country but does not directly measure human development, which is better captured by indices like the Human Development Index (HDI).
 
• GDP focuses on the value of goods and services produced, not factors such as health, education, or inequality.
 
 
 
• Externalities are not taken into account while estimating GDP.
 
 
• This statement is correct.
 
• GDP does not account for externalities, which are the unintended positive or negative effects of economic activities (e.g., pollution, environmental degradation).
 
• These impacts are not reflected in GDP calculations, even though they influence societal well-being.
 
 
 
• Services provided by housewives are included while estimating GDP.
 
• This statement is incorrect.
 
 
• GDP only includes market-based activities—those involving monetary transactions.
 
• Services like household work done by housewives (or unpaid domestic labor) are not included because they do not involve monetary transactions in the formal economy.
